strings.앗, %s! 어서와요!\n아바마마~ 기다리시던 사람이 왔어요!:
Oh, %s! Welcome!
Father! The person you've been waiting for is here!
Ah, %s. I am glad to see you looking well.
strings.말하자면 길지만… 용건만 단도직입적으로! 저와 함께 제 고향으로 여행을: It's a long story, so I'll get straight to the point! I'd like you to travel with me to my homeland!
She tells me she comes from another continent, beyond Jiendia.
That's right. The continent I come from is called [Freios].
strings.%s, 그대는 플라티나와 함께 프레이오스로 가서 그녀가 사는 세계를 확인: %s, accompany Platina to Freios and see the world in which she lives.
First, there are a few things I'd like to ask.
strings.1. 왜 제게 이런 부탁을 하시는건가요?: 1. Why are you asking me to do this?
I am told the portal that has appeared in Midgard was created entirely by chance.
strings.나로서는 호위단장 레비 아렌스경에게 임무를 맡기고 싶었으나… 궁중마법사들: I had intended to entrust the mission to Sir Levi Arens, captain of the royal guard... But the court mages report that the portal in Midgard is highly unstable, and extremely dangerous for a native of Jiendia to use.
strings.%s 그대처럼, 다른 세계에서 온 모험가들에게는 큰 문제가 아니라고 하는: For adventurers from another world, such as yourself, %s, it should pose no great difficulty.
strings.또한, 플라티나경 역시 그대에게 용무가 있는 것 같으니…: Besides, Dame Platina appears to have business with you as well...
2. You speak of another continent as though it were another world...
You sensed that from my words? You have keen instincts...
strings.프레이오스라는 이름은 생소하지 않도다. 역사서에는 그 이름이 분명히 명시: The name Freios is not unfamiliar to me. It is clearly recorded in our histories. You will find the names Freios, Otros, and other continents there.
strings.그러나 오랜 세월, 우리 지엔디아의 백성들은 다른 대륙의 존재를 잊은 채: Yet for many long years, the people of Jiendia have lived as though those other continents did not exist.
strings.짐은 그것이 그저 교역을 하기에는 다른 대륙들이 너무나 먼 곳에 있기 때: I had thought it was simply because those lands lay too far away for trade... But perhaps there was another reason.
strings.짐은 그대의 여행을 통하여 이 의문을 해결할 셈이니라. 새로운 땅에서 보: I intend to resolve that mystery through your journey. Overlook nothing you see or hear in this new land.
strings.3. 플라티나씨의 목적은 뭐지요?: 3. What is your purpose, Miss Platina?
My purpose...? Ahaha... Please don't look at me so suspiciously.
strings.%s님을 만난 순간 알았어요. %s님을, %s님이 아직 접하지 못한 세계: The moment I met you, %s, I knew. My mission was to guide you, %s, into a world you had yet to encounter, %s.
As a [Holy Order], I have a special intuition.
strings.어느날 갑자기 내린 [푸른 용]의 신탁에 따라 여행을 떠났다가 폭풍에 휘: One day, I unexpectedly received an oracle from the [Blue Dragon] and set out on a journey. Then a storm swept me here, to the legendary continent of Jiendia... and Xenadia.
strings.그리고, 당신을 만났지요. 이번 제 여행의 목적은 아마도 [당신]일 거에: And there, I met you. Perhaps the purpose of this journey of mine is [you].
This meeting is meant to lead you into a new world.
And this little journey will one day swell into a mighty wave and carry great meaning.
strings.(세계? 너무 스케일이 큰 이야기라 상상이 가지 않는걸….): (The world? That's so grand I can hardly imagine it...)
strings.뭐, 너무 심각하게 생각할 필요 없어요!: Well, there's no need to take it too seriously!
strings.사람은 그저 자신에게 주어진 짧은 시간을 최선을 다해 살아가면 되는 것!: We need only make the most of the brief time we're given!
strings.미소녀 성기사 플라티나♡와 함께 짧고 두근두근한 여행을 즐겨보지 않을래요: So, won't you join the beautiful young paladin Platina♡ for a short, heart-pounding adventure? >_<
strings.(두근두근! 좋겠다. 나도 가고 싶어~): (Heart-pounding! That sounds wonderful. I want to go too!)
strings.(과연 이국의 처자라 그런지 쾌활하고 외양적이구나! 나도 십년만 젊었다면: (Such a cheerful, outgoing young lady! Perhaps it's her foreign upbringing. If only I were ten years younger, I'd set off on an adventure myself... What a shame.)
strings.좋다. 그러면 미드가르드로 가거라, 도시 중심가에 처음 보는 형태의 포탈: Very well. Go to Midgard. In the city center, you will find a portal unlike any you have seen before.
strings.포탈 너머에 존재하는 세상이 어떤 곳인지 세세히 살펴 짐에게 알려주도록: Examine the world beyond that portal carefully, and report back to me.
strings.그대 앞을 기다리고 있는 모든 모험에 행운과 축복이 함께 하길!: May fortune and blessings accompany you on every adventure that awaits!
Dame Platina, our meeting was brief, but most enjoyable. I hope you will visit again.
Thank you, Your Majesty. I enjoyed it very much as well.
strings.헤르네 공주님도 반가왔어요. 잘 지내셔야해요?: It was lovely meeting you too, Princess Herne. Take good care of yourself, all right?
strings.으, 응… 플라티나 언니도.. 꼭 다시 들려줘야 해요! 알겠지요?: Y-yes... You too, Platina. You must visit again! Promise?
strings.(…언니라니, 많이 친해졌나보네.): (...That was awfully familiar. They must have become close.)
strings.그럼 %s, 미드가르드라는 도시로 가지요! 안내해주세요!: Then let's go to this city called Midgard, %s! Lead the way!
So this is the portal. I can feel magic swirling violently around it.
strings.확실히… 상당히 위험해보이네요. 플라티나씨는 괜찮으시겠어요?: Yes... It does look rather dangerous. Will you be all right, Miss Platina?
strings.제 걱정은 하지 않으셔도 돼요. 이래 보여도 건강한 편이니까요!: No need to worry about me. I'm sturdier than I look!
strings.음… 알았어요. 그럼… 갑니다!: Hmm... All right. Then... here we go!
strings.에잇, 어지럽네!… %s님은 괜찮으세요?: Oof, I'm dizzy!... Are you all right, %s?
I think so. Oh... This place...
strings.음.. 저도 처음 보는 숲인데요, 으음, 어디에 떨어진거지…?: Hmm. I've never seen this forest either. Where have we landed...?
Oh dear. Are we lost? Well... let's start walking, at least.
Let's! Hehe, you don't seem nervous at all.
strings.이런 일은 익숙하니까요. 게다가…: I'm used to this sort of thing. Besides...
The air is so refreshing... I have a good feeling about this.
strings.…!! 수없이 많은 땅덩어리가 하늘에 떠 있어…?: ...! All those pieces of land are floating in the sky...?
Freios... It's no ordinary continent. I'm amazed.
Hehe... I surprised you. That was rather fun.
strings.과거에는 프레이오스도 지엔디아처럼 바다에 몸을 담근 평범한 땅이었다고 해: They say Freios used to be an ordinary landmass surrounded by the sea, just like Jiendia. Not that Jiendia is exactly ordinary... Anyway.
strings.하지만 [신화시대] 에 빛과 어둠의 거대한 전투의 여파로 그만 산산조각이: But during the [Age of Myth], a tremendous battle between light and darkness shattered it, leaving it as you see it now.
I don't know the detailed history myself... You can look into it as you travel.
strings.오케이. 그럼 지금 우리가 발을 딛고 있는 이 땅은 어디죠? 지엔디아는: Okay. Then where are we standing now? This doesn't seem to be Jiendia... Is it yet another continent?
Hmm... I think this region may be [Mirgandia].
strings.프레이오스의 땅덩어리중 유일하게 지상에 남아있는 땅이지요. 이 지역으로: The only part of Freios that remained on the ground. As I understand it, the [Gate] leading here was lost long ago, so no one has set foot here in ages.
strings.에.. 그건 좀 곤란하게 된거 아닌가요?: Uh... Doesn't that put us in a bit of a predicament?
strings.뭐, 어떻게든 되겠죠? 아까 좋은 예감이 들었다고 했지요? 나도 그렇거든: Well, I'm sure we'll manage somehow. You said you had a good feeling, didn't you? So do I. Hehe.
strings.음… 플라티나씨도 그렇다니 왠지 힘이 나는데요. 그럼 앞으로 가보죠!: Hmm... Hearing you say that gives me confidence. Let's keep going!
strings.휴우, 작동하는 게이트를 발견해서 다행이에요. 음…. 좋아! 이 곳은 제: Whew, thank goodness we found a working Gate. Hmm... Good! This is a place I know well!
strings.길을 찾았다니 다행이군요. 그런데 방금 통과한 이 커다란 포탈은 뭐죠?: I'm glad we've found our way. But what was that enormous portal we just passed through? And where are we?
strings.아, 이건 [임페리얼 게이트] 라고 해요. 이 곳은 [허공해] 라고 하는: Oh, that's an [Imperial Gate]. This place is the [Void Sea], a sea in the sky filled with magic!
strings.보시다시피 프레이오스는 이 곳 [허공해]에 떠 있는 수많은 하늘섬으로 이: As you can see, Freios is a continent made up of countless sky islands floating in the [Void Sea].
strings.그래서 [구 제국]은, 세계 곳곳에 저런 게이트를 세운거죠. 굉장히 멀리: So the [Old Empire] built Gates like that all over the world. Even places far away can be reached in an instant through them.
strings.평범한 포탈과는 다른건가요?: Are they different from ordinary portals?
strings.으음…. 저는 힘민체 캐지 지능캐가 아니라서 그 이상 물으면 이, 이렇게: Umm... I'm a Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution build, not an Intelligence build. Ask me anything more and th-this is what happens...
strings.이제부터 갈 곳에는 마법사들이 많으니까, 그들에게 물어보면 잘 알려줄거에: There are plenty of mages where we're going. Ask them, and they'll explain it properly.
Here we are at last. This is the headquarters of the Guild Union.
strings.프레이오스에서의 모험을 시작하기에 딱 좋은 도시로 왔네요. 자, 잠시 헤: We've arrived at the perfect city to begin an adventure in Freios. Now it's time for us to part for a while, %s!
strings.에, 플라티나씨? 어디로 가시는건가요?: Oh, Miss Platina? Where are you going?
strings.(…지금 헤어지지 않으면 %s님의 존재를 그들이 알아버릴거야. %s님을: (...If we don't part now, they'll discover %s's existence. I can't put %s in danger yet...!)
strings.모처럼 돌아왔으니 미뤄두었던 일들을 좀 해야 할 것 같아요. 아아~ 게으: Since I'm finally back, I'd better take care of some things I've been putting off. Ahh, I'm so lazy that the work always piles up!
strings.그렇군요…. 에이, 아쉽네요. 같이 여행하면 즐거울텐데요!: I see... Aw, that's a shame. It would be fun to travel together!
strings.저도 아쉬워요. 앞으로 %s님이 무얼 보고 어떤 일을 하실 것인지, 정말: I'll miss it too. I'm so curious about what you'll see and do, %s.
strings.하지만 금방 다시 만날거란 예감이 드니까, 지금은 웃으며 헤어지기로 해요: But I have a feeling we'll meet again soon, so let's part with a smile for now. Goodbye, %s! Good luck!
strings.(………플라티나씨는 가버렸다. 이 낯선 곳에서 혼자가 되버렸네. 마치 라: (...Miss Platina is gone. Now I'm alone in this unfamiliar place. It feels just like when I first came to the world of La Tale.)
strings.(이제부터는 혼자서 부딪혀보는거야. 자, 힘내서 가자!): (From here on, I'll have to find my own way. All right—let's get going!)
